items.title: NextEra-Dominion merger hearings kick off with focus on scope
items.summary: The case is “simply not the one to litigate the cost of service [or] who's paying their fair share ... including the data centers,” said Joe Reid, an attorney representing NextEra and Dominion, in his opening remarks to the Virginia State Corporation Commission.

items.title: Virginia regulators start Dominion-NextEra merger hearing
items.summary: Virginia regulators began formal hearings Tuesday to decide whether to approve a $67 billion merger proposal between Dominion Energy and NextEra Energy that would create the world’s largest regulated electric utility.
